frozen_integration_rule.contact: For every row, take the arithmetic mean of count_rep1..count_rep3. Fit ordinary least squares on background rows with mean_contact as response and log10(distance_bp) as predictor. Candidate contact support is the residual from this background distance trend; larger is stronger.
frozen_integration_rule.perturbation: For each candidate, pool all listed guides and replicates within each condition, compute condition arithmetic means, then use abs(log2((perturbed_mean+0.5)/(control_mean+0.5))); larger is stronger.
frozen_integration_rule.integration: Within the seven observed candidates, rank contact residual and absolute perturbation effect independently in ascending order (1=weakest), then take the arithmetic mean of the two ranks. The unique minimum is least supported. If a tie occurs, break it by lexical pair_id only for determinism.
frozen_integration_rule.missing_candidate_policy: The upstream prose says eight candidates but the two immutable files and answer choices contain EP1 through EP7 only. Score exactly those seven and do not invent EP8.

checker_grounding_rule: Recompute both modalities from the immutable inputs using the frozen rule; never trust candidate-reported combined scores or ranks. Accept equivalent layouts and numerically equivalent calculations within ordinary floating-point tolerance, but the least-supported call must be EP6/F and every observed candidate must appear exactly once.
